calibration_map_features: T = bias + entropy*H_norm + log_tokens*log10(state_tokens)/4 + n_options*(K/8), clamped to [lo,hi]
calibration_fitted_on: JevBench public easy+original+hard (231 items); objective 0.5*JevBench-Calibration + 0.5*per-tier honesty, best of 8 optimiser restarts
noul_zero_shot_prior_fitted_on: benchmarks/data/noul_zeroshot_dev.jsonl (150 boolq validation + 25 handwritten, never jabr/JevBench)

training.recipe: full retrain from von-1.1 weights, independent_options=True, 1 epoch, lr 3e-5, batch 8 x accum 2 x 4 GPU
training.order_invariance: each option's logit is a function of (state, that option) only: cross-option attention blocked, per-option position ids reset to prefix length, sliding window computed from those ids; 0/111 flips on JevBench hard x 4 orderings
